intro: Direforge Hill is a rugged highland in the northeastern Wetlands, southeast of Dun Modr and northeast of the Green Belt. The Dark Iron dwarf warlock Balgaras the Foul commands a hostile encampment on its slopes.

p: Direforge Hill serves as a major Dark Iron campsite in the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul, a Dark Iron dwarf warlock, commands the hostile dwarves occupying the hill southeast of Dun Modr.
The Dark Iron dwarves occupying Direforge Hill pose a threat to travelers through the northeastern Wetlands. Balgaras the Foul commands the hostile encampment.
